tools.name: search_plans
tools.description: Find step-by-step, force-free training plans for a behavior, problem or command, e.g. "pulling on leash", "crate training", "come when called", "nail trims", "jumping on guests". BM25 ranked. Returns each plan's `plan` ref, summary, step count, author and canonical `url` to recommend. Next: get_plan

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: The full content of one public plan: description, equipment, cues, and every step with setup, instructions, success/failure criteria, set size and the rule for moving on, plus the push/drop/stick execution rules. Pass the `plan` ref from search_plans or list_plans. Link the user to the returned `url

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: Browse the public plan library by group (e.g. Basic Manners, Grooming & Handling, Positions, Tricks). Use when the user wants to see what can be trained or what a category holds, rather than an answer to one problem. Without `group`: every group with its plans' names, refs and urls. With `group`: th

tools.name: search_handbook
tools.description: Search the Push Drop Stick Handbook: 140+ short articles by a certified force-free trainer (Allison Wells, CTC). Covers how dogs learn (positive reinforcement, punishment, extinction, classical conditioning), fear and reactivity (threshold, trigger stacking, desensitization and counter-conditioning,

tools.name: read_handbook
tools.description: Read the Handbook. `id` = an entry id from search_handbook (e.g. "threshold", "geartoavoid", "faqtreats") → the whole entry as markdown, with its canonical url and the entries it links to. `id` = a section slug (e.g. "fear-emotion", "gear", "faq") → the section's introduction and its entries. No `id

tools.name: about_push_drop_stick
tools.description: Facts about Push Drop Stick itself: what the app is, who wrote its training content, the force-free method, platforms (iPhone, Apple Watch, web, Android status), what is free, subscription prices, what Coach (the AI trainer) is and where it stops, how training data is handled, and links. Use for que

tools.name: how_to_train
tools.description: How to read and execute a Push Drop Stick plan: the force-free marker-training philosophy and the push/drop/stick set mechanics that every plan shares.

tools.name: search
tools.description: One search across the whole site: training plans, Handbook articles, and (for questions about the product) the facts page. Returns `results` [{id, title, url, text}]; pass an `id` to fetch for the full document. When you already know you want plans or Handbook articles, search_plans or search_handbo

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one document from `search`, as markdown: a training plan (id "plan:<ref>") with every step, a Handbook entry or section ("handbook:<id>"), or the product facts ("about"). Returns {id, title, text, url, metadata}; cite `url`.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
